title: Edge AI Is Not Free. Here Is the Bill.
description: A model that runs comfortably on a data-centre GPU may be too slow or too large on the target hardware. The device has limited compute, memory, energy and cooling.So engineers reach for quantization, pruning, smaller architectures or specialized accelerators. Every one of those optimizations can affect latency, power and accuracy - which is why the system has to be measured on the real device rather than predicted.Episode 02 measures exactly that: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QB7cgfILOVIThis episode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Pg186B2x1sFull series playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDSu5OGSP38U#EdgeAI #OnDeviceAI #MachineLearning #AIEngineering
